challenges.title: Beat the Heat
challenges.question: Which action saves the most energy when cooling your home?

options.text: Keep the windows open while the AC is running

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Setting the AC around 24–26°C saves energy.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Setting the AC around 24–26°C saves energy.

challenges.title: Skip Single-Use Plastic
challenges.question: What is the best way to avoid a single-use drink bottle?

options.text: Use a new plastic bottle each time
Recycle a disposable cup after every drink

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! A reusable bottle helps prevent single-use waste.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Carrying a reusable water bottle avoids single-use waste.
